data.text:
‘KAILANGAN PONG KUMPLETUHIN ANG REBOLUSYON’

Sen. Bam Aquino on Sunday said he keeps commemorating the People Power Revolution because its stories and promises are not yet finished, citing ongoing corruption scandals and other pressing issues.

During the EDSA 40 Mass and Prayer Rally at the EDSA Shrine, he recounted his experience during the historic revolution and emphasized why the voice of the youth is important in carrying forward the story of the People Power Revolution.
